purpose: How finely each roadmap is planned (PROTOCOL.md section 2). A roadmap near the front of the line is planned at lemma level, as is one the maintainer picks for formalisation by adding its id to lemmaLevel. A roadmap is near the front when its prerequisites are mostly built, meaning its distance from the libraries in data/roadmap-classification.json is at most lemmaLevelMaxDistance. Every other roadmap is planned at target level: its stages' targets, the definitions and key theorems they need, and how they connect to the libraries and to other roadmaps.
